Toronto Police Issue Hundreds of Tickets for Bike Lane Violations

Toronto police have issued over 300 tickets to riders of micro-mobility devices, including e-bikes and e-scooters. Additionally, more than 1,200 tickets were issued to vehicles found parked in designated bike lanes. The enforcement action targeted violations related to the use of personal transportation devices and the obstruction of cycling infrastructure.
